get_language('nonexistent_xyz') returns an error for unknown language

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try {
        var language = TreeSitterLanguagePack.getLanguage("nonexistent_xyz");
        System.out.println(language);
        } catch (TreeSitterLanguagePackRsException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
